John spent $200 on blue ties that cost $40 each, so he bought 200 / 40 = 5 blue ties.  
He bought twice as many red ties as blue ties, so he bought 2 × 5 = 10 red ties.  
Red ties cost 50% more than blue ties, so each red tie costs 40 + (0.50 × 40) = $60.  
He spent 10 × 60 = $600 on red ties.  
Total spent = $200 + $600 = $800.

Answer: $800
